transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... work made me come in. They said I was... scaring people. 

I guess I've been freezing up in the middle of service. Just... doing things out of order. Like, the other day I was just standing by the soda station with the cash drawer key. I was supposed to be closing out checks, but I was just standing there... repeating table numbers out loud. 

I don't really know. They just told me I had to come see someone.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to?

I guess... sometimes. 

Like when I'm closing up at work, or just in my kitchen at home. I'll hear... a woman. She just says my name, or tells me I'm doing the cash count wrong. It sounds real enough that I... I usually answer her back. Before I realize nobody else is around.
When you freeze up like that, do you lose awareness of what’s happening around you?
I don't think so. Um... I know I'm still at work. I just... get stuck for a minute. I can still hear people and everything, I just... I don't know.
Do you believe someone is trying to harm you or control what you do?

I don't know about... harm. 

But I... I guess I feel like some people at work are... watching me. A couple of the other servers. And there's this one regular customer. 

I just... I feel like they watch how I ring things in. And they leave these little signs on the tickets. Like they're trying to prove I'm messing up so they can get me fired. 

My husband says it's just... normal restaurant mistakes. But I don't know. It feels different.
Before these experiences started, had you begun using any drugs or new medications?
No. Um... no new medications. And I don't... I don't use drugs.
How long have these experiences been going on?

Um... a while, I guess. 

Probably... about a year and two months. That's... that's when they asked me to take on the evening shift lead stuff at work. It feels like it's just been building up since then.
Outside of work, have you had trouble keeping up with basic daily things like showering, cooking, paying bills, or spending time with people?

Um... I guess things have been... harder. 

At work, they're... they're talking about taking away the shift-lead stuff. Because of the mistakes. And... I guess I get confused sometimes during closing. It slows things down. 

And at home... I don't know. My husband says I'm... not really there. Like I'm barely present anymore. So... yeah. I guess things are a little hard.
During this past year, have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Um... no. I don't think so. 

Not... not depressed. Just... dealing with everything, I guess. But no. I haven't really felt sad like that.
Before this started, were you functioning better at work and at home than you are now?

Yeah... I guess so. Like I was just saying, it's... it's gotten bad now. With the mistakes slowing everything down, I'm probably going to lose that shift-lead spot. And my husband... you know, saying I'm not really present with him anymore. 

Before all this started... I didn't have those issues. I was doing fine.
Have you had any seizures?
No. I haven't had anything like that.
Have you had any head injury?
No... I haven't hit my head or anything like that.
Have you found yourself talking much less than you used to?

Yeah... I guess. When my husband tries to talk with me, I mostly just sit there. I don't know... it just feels like I can’t get myself to care, or really start anything. Even talking. 

It's kind of like that with everything right now. I don’t really go for beach walks, or bake, or garden much anymore. I used to write in my journal, but I don't really do that either. I just... sit there.
Have other people told you that your speech has been hard to follow or doesn't make sense?
No... I don't think so. Nobody has said that to me. But I guess I'm not really talking enough lately for them to notice anyway.
Have you been getting confused about where you are or what day it is?
No... I know where I am. I haven't had any trouble with that.
Have you had any major medical illness recently?
No... not that I know of. I haven't been sick or anything.
When you freeze up, has anyone said you stay completely still in one position for a long time?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, no one has told me that.
Have people told you that your face looks blank or that you show much less emotion than you used to?

My husband... he says something like that. When he tries to talk to me, I mostly just sit there. I don't know. It just feels like I can't get myself to care... or start anything. I don't really do much anymore. I used to go for beach walks, or bake... garden, write in my journal. But I don't really do any of that now.
Have you noticed your memory getting worse?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed anything like that. My memory seems... fine, I guess.
Have you had trouble finding the right words when speaking?
No, not really. I think I talk fine. Just... I don't really have much to say.
Have other people said that your behavior has seemed very strange or disorganized?

Um... yeah. The people at work... they got kind of scared, I guess. I wait tables, and they said I was doing things out of order. Like... I would just freeze up in the middle of service. 

They said they found me standing by the soda station once... holding the key to the cash drawer. Just... repeating table numbers out loud. Instead of actually closing out the checks. So... yeah. They thought that was strange.
